metaTitle: Custom Half Drop Products | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom half drop products in bulk. Perfect for branding with screen printing or embroidery. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Half drop products feature a design that repeats vertically offset by half the width, creating a seamless, flowing pattern ideal for large surfaces like bags, apparel, and accessories. This layout is popular for corporate uniforms, promotional giveaways, and retail merchandise where a sophisticated, repeating motif is desired. Whether you need custom tote bags or branded hats, the half drop arrangement ensures your logo or pattern looks cohesive and professional across multiple items in your order.
heroAltText: Custom half drop products with repeating offset pattern on tote bags and apparel for branding.
